# Cache fixtures

**Origin**: generated by `tools/gen_cache_fixtures.py` (T-0321), formula-defined content only. The
sqlite region file `cache_sqlite/map/z1/0/0/0.0.sqlitedb` used to be a verbatim copy of a tile cached by a
live SAS.Planet install (a real Google Maps z0 tile); for the public release it is SYNTHETIC: a 256x256
8-bit RGB gradient PNG written with zlib/struct (no third-party imagery). Regenerate with
`tools/gen_cache_fixtures.py --out tests/fixtures/cache` (`--check` diffs). Output is byte-identical between
runs on the same SQLite library (the file header records the SQLite version number).

**Cache type present**: the **SQLite region-file cache** (`cache_sqlite/`) plus the nine folder layouts. The
BerkeleyDB backend is removed (see "BerkeleyDB" below).

**Container layout** (identical to what the legacy SQLite cache writes): 4096-byte pages, WAL journal mode
(checkpointed into the single file, no `-wal`/`-shm`), `CREATE TABLE t (x INTEGER NOT NULL,y INTEGER NOT
NULL,v INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,c TEXT,s INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,h INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,d INTEGER
NOT NULL,b BLOB,constraint PK_TB primary key (x,y,v))` plus `CREATE INDEX t_v_idx on t (v)`.

**Content**: `t` has **exactly 1 row**:
```
x=0 y=0 v=0 c=NULL s=1435 h=crc32(blob)=3871830875 d=1789643597 blob_len=1435
```
(`s` = byte size, `h` = CRC-32 of the blob, `d` = load date 2026-09-17 11:13:17 as the tests read it, `b` = the PNG).
This exercises the schema and a single round-trip read, but not multiple zoom levels/shards in one region
file, TNE rows or a populated content type (`c`); those are covered by tests that build their own files.

**What it exercises**: FEAT items for the SQLite tile-cache reader: region-file path layout, table/index
schema, per-tile columns (size/hash/date/blob) and single-tile read.

## Wanted (docs/specs/storage.md §7.5)

None of these can be generated honestly (§7.1); the dependent tests `GTEST_SKIP()` naming the
exact path until each arrives.

- `cache/foreign/sample.mbtiles` — an `.mbtiles` written by a native MBTiles tool (e.g. `mb-util`,
  QGIS, TileMill), **not** by SAS.Planet -- every file this port can create itself carries its own
  `name`/`description`/`scheme=tms` metadata, so it cannot stand in for a genuinely foreign file.
  Blocks `MbtilesConnection.ForeignMbtilesFile` (`tests/storage/mbtiles_test.cpp`, T-0022C2).
- `cache/foreign/sample.rmaps` — a `.rmaps` written by a native RMaps app, **not** by SAS.Planet --
  every RMaps/OsmAnd/Locus file this port can create itself carries its own `info.sasgis` column
  (docs/specs/storage.md §7.5 item 5). Blocks `RmapsConnection.ForeignRMapsFile`
  (`tests/storage/rmaps_test.cpp`, T-0022C3).
- `cache/foreign/sample_oruxmaps.db` plus its sibling `*.otrk2.xml` — an OruxMaps `.db` written by
  the OruxMaps application, small, any map (docs/specs/storage.md §7.5 item 6). Blocks
  `OruxmapsConnection.RealOruxMapsSample` (`tests/storage/oruxmaps_test.cpp`, T-0022D1).

### BerkeleyDB

No longer wanted: the BerkeleyDB backend was removed (T-0333, owner 2026-10-21; snapshot: tag `archive/with-berkeleydb`).
